All original field/source chunks and separate signed-input records have exact original restore identities.
C.result_scope: Actual R88 conditional selected two-mode cut existence only. Modes 2 and 4 are the selected cut outputs; the remaining 18 parameters are fixed uniformly in the same radius 3/4. This is not the later R119 full-centre assertion, all 46 cuts, high-frequency outer PDE, or a full closed-surface result.

D.derivation: Recompute the complete optimal-frame budget over the two saved original cell manifests and all original panels, consuming the complete background-flow output E3 and original cut trace. Cell010/cell011 files are completed per-cell derived budget records emitted by the same invocation.
D.result_scope: Full-frequency homogeneous strip bound; the saved flags explicitly leave nonlinear Green/Schur inverse and complete outer solution unpaid.

E.derivation: The positive-endpoint wrapper retains the original background-flow algorithm, the two whole original cell manifests, ready record and real inner columns. Recreate all panels for modes 2 and 4 using the exact r2 command; per-cell files are generated result records, not irrecoverable inputs.
E.result_scope: Completed finite background flow for cells 11 then 10. It does not pay all 46 modes, the entire outer range, nonlinear Schur inverse or full-frequency source kernel.

F.derivation: The first two reports are recomputable full continuous candidate-defect enclosures for original cells 10 and 11. The other two are generated domain replay outputs of the source recorder. Restore the original complete candidate/ports/ready/cell input chain and, for replay, the exact original reference-defect bytes before invoking the recorded command.
F.result_scope: All saved even modes through 40, full mean radial derivative and continuous Darboux defect enclosures remain part of each original result. A paid defect enclosure is not an exact radial solution.

G.derivation: Each complete resource command composes nine fully recorded pieces from its specified candidate/audit/resource inputs. Previous, unchanged and original input-hash mappings are preserved in the 269-entry input registry. A prior composition output must be restored before any later composition that checks its complete bytes.
G.result_scope: The new-seg1 family actually changes the candidate on that substage while preserving the stated common background and endpoint jets; it is not relabelled as the same candidate as every earlier composition. The source/exact-solution/Green-Schur unpaid flags remain unchanged.

H.derivation: Exact rational algebra on the six complete saved input files in the unchanged original input manifest produces all 46 axes, the full T block and every block row. Restore each original file before recreating its recorded working-copy path; a path substitution never authorizes different mathematical data.
H.result_scope: The original complete K contraction and its inverse bound concern that full saved map and domain. The failed old hybrid Lipschitz diagnostic is retained separately. No external t-family, all outer cells or closed surface is inferred.

I.derivation: Exact interval/rational postprocessing of the complete original Taylor-flow, signed-cut, M20-response and cell11-defect reports. All four inputs and actual argv remain recoverable; no new ODE/source integration is substituted.
I.result_scope: Exact linear variation-of-constants cancellation with the complete nonlinear true-head term retained. The full nonlinear outer Schur residual and full46/infinite-frequency inverse remain unpaid.

J.derivation: Recompute the low 12-to-13 material-edge coefficient from its complete saved inputs using the original 46-mode command; no new radial ODE/source integrations were used. The PB successor is a genuine old reader of this exact cheap-edge result.
J.result_scope: The low material bound does not pay the full 213 matrix or the joint gate.

K.derivation: K1 builds the explicitly different last physical-radius piece with the other eight representations retained. K2 reads the same specified candidate at two actual witness points with complete mean treatment. K3/K4 reapply all original full-J mathematics to refined moments of the same true piece. K5 is the complete original BigInt deriveSeg7Curvature(raw) calculation on three exact input texts, not an invented Python/Node command.
K.result_scope: K2's second two-angle witness proves a strictly positive actual defect, while the first does not. Both are finite-point results. R95's actual-solution jet-error assumption remains unpaid, so its conditional curvature bound is not an actual full-tail curvature certificate.

consumer_and_restore_contract.details: The deletion does not claim that the path was never used. It changes storage only. Restore its complete recorded Git bytes before use and retain every original source/input hash guard. No new reader alias or relaxed guard is introduced.

restoration_protocol.exact_old_bytes: Use git show FIXED_COMMIT:topics/visible-flex-larger-amplitude/RELATIVE_PATH to restore the exact blob at the old path. Each delete entry supplies the old byte length, SHA-256 and Git blob. Input records default to the original 60321451... commit; explicit recorded exceptions take precedence.
restoration_protocol.sources_and_parameters: Keep all producer/helper/proof/plan/resource/config files. The complete original resource objects above preserve every argv word, the exact wrapper, precision, budgets, original timing/exit/signal and failure/null fields. Source and input registry gives exact restoration metadata for whole files.
restoration_protocol.original_working_paths: For the H manifest, restore each registered public file whole and copy those same bytes to its original manifest path (or construct an explicitly new manifest with the same exact hashes). Do not edit the original manifest and pretend its whole identity is unchanged.
restoration_protocol.regenerated_outputs: Original numerical recipes are reproducible from complete preserved sources, parameters and inputs. Fresh paths, timers, RSS, serialization or compressed headers may change newly generated whole bytes. For an old whole-SHA consumer restore the original bytes from Git; never claim a new timed report automatically equals the old report.
restoration_protocol.scientific_execution: Any future numerical regeneration is a separate authorized public Actions computation, not part of this source-only retention. No new fixture, rerun, AST/compile or numerical verification is a prerequisite to ordinary retention publication.
restoration_protocol.fresh_root_action: Root compares every candidate against fresh current-tree path/Git blob/size and deletes only exact matches in an ordinary commit. No force update or active queue mutation is delegated here.
